want: change a repo this session has not attached
who: the session, after attaching the repo with its add_repo tool
lands: a pull request in that repo, with its own hook and checks
catch: only a repo the account's GitHub app reaches, which the session's repository list shows

want: make a small edit in a repo no session has open
who: you, two taps in the Proposals view
lands: a commit, a branch or a draft pull request, as you choose
catch: four kinds only: replace a whole file, set or remove one top-level JSON field, delete an issue

who: you, one tap on the Stage
lands: the folder the repo declares as its inbox
catch: new files only; it does not edit a file already there

want: have Gemini do work on the laptop
who: nobody, once a session files the errand and the laptop is awake
catch: an errand never commits to the repo the work concerns; a second step carries the output there

want: have Gemini change a repo on the laptop
lands: a gemini/ branch in that repo
catch: its clone needs npm run setup first, or the commit hook never runs and the derived-artifact check fails

want: read a page a session cannot reach
who: you, one bookmark tap on that page
catch: a courier script reads and returns; it never navigates or writes

want: run a script on the work machine
who: you, pasting it into the PowerShell ISE and pasting its output back
catch: no agent runs on the work machine and nothing there writes to git; the result returns only through your paste

want: edit a file from my phone
lands: a commit on main or on a new branch
catch: no commit hook runs, so generated files stay stale until a session or npm run artifacts:refresh repairs them

want: have Claude do a task on a schedule
who: nobody; a Routine starts the session
lands: a branch and pull request; tracker state on main
catch: the session starts from a fresh clone, with none of your files

want: run a script on a schedule
catch: GitHub's machines have CPU only and none of your files; a script that needs the laptop belongs in a daemon row

want: work on files on my own computer
who: you, in Claude Code or Cowork there
lands: a local copy until it pushes
catch: the work is invisible to every other session until it reaches a branch
